For some orientation of the same six physical banks, the product of three pairwise-disjoint cross-block Frobenius-square energies exceeds 1/3981312.

For any physical cross block C with E2=e2(CC^T)>0, at the ridge scale tr K=3/2, if max diag K<=1/2 then sup_z E|z-R|^(-1/2) <= 3*2^(31/24)*sqrt(e)*E2^(-1/8)<12.109 E2^(-1/8), in the completed fractional-ridge theorem's arbitrary-self/outside-coupling scope.

The aggregate heavy packet does not force one dimension-free physical singleton edge or one dimension-free 3x3 minor; the explicit B_m family has packet mass 1 while the largest such edge is m^(-1/2) and each nonzero third-minor square is 1/m.

Pay the physical cascade with arbitrary self blocks/cross contamination, or route it to existing square-pivot/grouped/ridge endpoints. In the diffuse C branch only the bank-level singleton hyperbolic transducer remains; in the heavy C branch recurse on ridge localization.
